docs.summary: Prowl's link to the GPU: one Vulkan device and one Graphite renderer for the application, and the frame every view and host pass joins before `SubmitFrame`. Without a window there is no device, and every GPU object stays absent while its CPU state works as usual.
The Vulkan device, null when headless.
The renderer every scene draws through, null when headless.
The window's swapchain, null when headless.
The largest width or height a texture may have.
How long the last `SubmitFrame` waited for the render thread, in milliseconds.
Frames submitted so far.
The name shown for the backend, such as in the editor's status bar.

members.name: DrawMeshInstanced
members.signature: public static void DrawMeshInstanced(Mesh mesh, Material material, ReadOnlySpan<Float4x4> transforms, ReadOnlySpan<Color> colors = default, ShadowCasting shadowCasting = ShadowCasting.On, int layer = 0, Scene? scene = null)

docs.summary: Draws a mesh once per transform, in world space, for this frame only, so call it every frame the instances should show, from Update or anywhere before the scene renders. Each colour tints its instance where the material's shader reads it, as Lit and Unlit do with Instance Tint on, and is white where missing. Draws into the current scene unless given one, and draws nothing while the mesh or material is still loading.
Disposes a GPU object once the frames that may use it have finished.
